providers.help:
ruflo providers
Manage AI providers, models, and configurations

SUBCOMMANDS:
  list            List available AI providers and models
  configure       Configure provider settings and API keys
  test            Test provider connectivity and API access
  models          List and manage available models
  usage           View provider usage and costs

EXAMPLES:
  $ claude-flow providers list
    List all providers
  $ claude-flow providers configure -p openai
    Configure OpenAI
  $ claude-flow providers test --all
    Test all providers

config.help:
ruflo config
Configuration management

SUBCOMMANDS:
  init            Initialize configuration
  get             Get configuration value
  set             Set configuration value
  providers       Manage AI providers
  reset           Reset configuration to defaults
  export          Export configuration
  import          Import configuration

EXAMPLES:
  $ claude-flow config init --v3
    Initialize V3 config
  $ claude-flow config get swarm.topology
    Get config value
  $ claude-flow config set swarm.maxAgents 20
    Set config value

proxy.help:
ruflo proxy
Meta LLM Proxy — install/lifecycle + sponsored downtime + power saver + training-data sharing (ADR-304/307/313/314/315)

SUBCOMMANDS:
  install         Download, verify, and install the meta-proxy binary (ADR-307)
  update          Re-verify and replace the installed binary with the pinned release (never automatic)
  start           Start meta-proxy (foreground by default; --service to detach)
  supervise       Internal detached supervisor for token refresh and meta-proxy lifecycle
  stop            Stop a running meta-proxy process
  status          Show meta-proxy install + process status
  logs            Show meta-proxy --service logs
  uninstall       Stop the proxy (if running), remove the binary, token, and consent receipt
  config          Toggle cloud routing and its tier selection (ADR-304/321) — local backends only by default
  sponsor-enable  Opt into Cognitum-sponsored downtime capacity (ADR-313)
  sponsor-disable Revoke sponsored-downtime consent and stop using sponsored capacity
  sponsor-status  Show sponsored-downtime consent + rate-limit flag state
  sponsor-clear   Clear the rate-limited flag (your Claude limit has reset)
  power-saver-enable Opt into power saver mode — route everyday requests through your own Cognitum account (ADR-314)
  power-saver-disable Revoke power-saver consent and stop routing through Cognitum for cost savings
  power-saver-status Show power-saver consent + quota-low flag state
  power-saver-clear Clear the quota-low flag
  training-share-enable Opt into sharing sponsored-plane interaction content for meta-llm training (ADR-315)
  training-share-disable Revoke training-data-sharing consent — stop sending the training consent header
  training-share-status Show training-data-sharing consent state

EXAMPLES:
  $ ruflo proxy install --yes
    Install the signed Meta-Proxy v0.7.3 binary
  $ ruflo proxy start
    Start meta-proxy in the foreground
  $ ruflo proxy status
    Show install + process status
  $ ruflo proxy config --cloud --yes
    Enable cloud routing (ADR-304)
  $ ruflo proxy config --routing-mode high
    Pin the cloud tier instead of auto (ADR-321)
  $ ruflo proxy config --passthrough
    Turn cloud routing off, back to your Claude subscription
  $ ruflo proxy config --local-only
    Revert to local-only routing
  $ ruflo proxy sponsor-status
    Show current sponsored-mode state
  $ ruflo proxy sponsor-enable --yes
    Opt into sponsored downtime capacity
  $ ruflo proxy power-saver-enable --yes
    Opt into power saver mode
  $ ruflo proxy training-share-enable --yes
    Opt into training-data sharing (ADR-315)

agent.help:
ruflo agent
Agent management commands

SUBCOMMANDS:
  spawn           Spawn a new agent
  list            List all active agents (ls)
  status          Show detailed status of an agent
  stop            Stop a running agent (kill)
  metrics         Show agent performance metrics
  pool            Manage agent pool for scaling
  health          Show agent health and metrics
  logs            Show agent activity logs
  wasm-status     Check rvagent-wasm availability, version, and capabilities
  wasm-create     Create a WASM-sandboxed agent
  wasm-prompt     Send a prompt to a WASM agent
  wasm-gallery    List available WASM agent gallery templates
  publish         Publish the AGNTCY-identified, OASF-described agent record to the configured Directory (ADR-380 §2)

EXAMPLES:
  $ claude-flow agent spawn -t coder
    Spawn a coder agent
  $ claude-flow agent list
    List all agents
  $ claude-flow agent status agent-001
    Show agent status
